title: Kimi K2.7 Code joins the text models
summary:
A new coding model and 1080p Wan video option landed alongside more flexible MCP voices and text parameters that finally take “false” for an answer.

Added Moonshot’s coding-focused `kimi-k2.7-code` through OpenRouter, with image input, tool use, reasoning, and a 262,144-token context window. It also accepts the `kimi-k2.7` and `kimi-k2p7` aliases.

Added `wan-pro-1080p` as a separate video model, while moving existing Wan video and Wan/Qwen image models to Replicate. Wan Pro supports an end-frame keyframe; Qwen Image supports editing with up to three reference images. `qwen-coder-large` moved to OpenRouter. The API docs were regenerated to include the 1080p model.

MCP audio tools accept voice names returned by `listAudioVoices` instead of limiting requests to a fixed list. An SDK alpha also keeps unfamiliar model categories in catalog results and makes HTTP error handling consistent across the client and React hooks. Unused package exports, widgets, and maintenance scripts were removed.

highlights.title: Kimi K2.7 Code
highlights.text: Try `kimi-k2.7-code` for coding tasks with reasoning, tools, up to 10 reference images, and a 262,144-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kimi-k2.7-code).

highlights.title: Wan Pro at 1080p
highlights.text: Generate 1080p video with the separate `wan-pro-1080p` model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=wan-pro-1080p).

highlights.title: Choose an end frame
highlights.text: Give `wan-pro` an end-frame keyframe to guide where a generated video finishes. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: More MCP audio voices
highlights.text: MCP audio tools accept voice names discovered through `listAudioVoices` instead of restricting requests to a fixed list. [See the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).
